name: The Gates Of Prosper
summary: The Gates of Prosper is a popular community shopping center in Prosper, Texas, featuring major national retailers including Dick's Sporting Goods, Walmart, TJ Maxx, Ross, Ulta Beauty, and PetSmart. With family-friendly dining options like Texas Roadhouse and a convenient location, it serves as a one-stop destination for the area's rapidly growing community.
demographics: The Gates of Prosper attracts affluent families and young professionals from one of the fastest-growing communities in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The trade area serves predominantly middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes exceeding $120,000, drawn by Prosper's highly-rated schools and master-planned communities. Primary shoppers include families with children seeking convenient access to everyday necessities, sporting goods, and family dining options, with a strong preference for value-oriented national retailers combined with quality service providers.
description: The Gates of Prosper is a thriving community shopping center strategically located at 700 Richland Boulevard in Prosper, Texas, serving one of the Dallas-Fort Worth area's most dynamic and rapidly expanding communities. This open-air retail destination brings together an impressive mix of national retailers and popular dining establishments that cater to the everyday needs of local families and residents. Anchored by major retailers including Dick's Sporting Goods, Walmart, Ross Dress for Less, TJ Maxx, Ulta Beauty, and PetSmart, the center offers a comprehensive shopping experience under one convenient location. Food enthusiasts can enjoy family-friendly dining at Texas Roadhouse alongside other restaurant options that make The Gates of Prosper a true gathering place for the community. With its strong tenant lineup, accessible location, and focus on value and convenience, The Gates of Prosper has established itself as an essential retail hub serving Prosper's growing population and the surrounding North Texas communities.
